items.v0_3_2_search_desc: Supports full guild and channel message search, syntax pill filtering (from/in/has/pinned), keyword highlighting, and one-click Jump to message.
items.v0_3_2_invite_desc: Resolves friend invite clicks having no response, auto-pre-generates invite codes, on-demand fallback creation, and automatic DM invite cards.
items.v0_3_2_header_desc: Refactors responsive header layout with tiered truncation, auto-collapsing search button, and guaranteed visible pin and member buttons.
items.v0_3_2_touch_desc: Removes touch-none constraint to restore smooth scrolling, with a 1450ms continuous gesture state machine seamlessly handling long-press menus and drag reordering.
items.v0_3_1_emoji_desc: Support for personal and server custom emojis with a Discord-style emoji picker and inline reaction rendering.
items.v0_3_1_status_badge_desc: Pixel-perfect SVG cutout indicators for idle crescent, DND bar, and offline ring presence states.
items.v0_3_1_typography_desc: 13px-20px global font scaling with intrinsic chat image dimensions to eliminate layout shifts.
items.v0_3_1_admin_desc: Super-admin toggle to restrict regular user server creation, tailored for dedicated private deployments.
items.v0_3_1_upload_title: Mobile Safari Uploads & Deep Magic Bytes
items.v0_3_1_upload_desc: Fix for iOS Safari avatar uploads with robust binary magic byte inspection and decompression bomb guards.
items.v0_3_0_unread_desc: See unread indicators, mark channels or servers as read, and sync progress across devices.
items.v0_3_0_appearance_desc: Adjust chat font size, message density, and interface zoom.
items.v0_3_0_roles_desc: Updated member and role layouts and prevented overlapping role changes.
items.v0_3_0_brand_desc: A unified mascot now appears across the web and desktop apps, with an unread indicator in the desktop tray.
items.v0_2_0_livekit_desc: Seamlessly integrates LiveKit and Cloudflare Realtime for crystal-clear multi-user voice calls and HD screen sharing.
items.v0_2_0_rnnoise_title: RNNoise Neural Network Real-Time Noise Suppression
items.v0_2_0_rnnoise_desc: Runs deep neural networks in an isolated AudioWorklet thread to eliminate keyboard clicks and fan noises with zero perceptible latency.
items.v0_2_0_i18n_desc: Fully localized across Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese (TW/HK), English, and Japanese with zero hardcoded strings.
items.v0_2_0_updater_title: Dual-Track Delta Hot Updates with gh-proxy Acceleration
items.v0_2_0_updater_desc: Decoupled web bundle and native shell updates with multi-tier proxy fallback directly connecting to GitHub Releases.
items.v0_2_0_perf_title: Virtual Message List & Local SQLite Optimizations
items.v0_2_0_perf_desc: Sub-millisecond loading of massive chat message histories and full-text search with significantly reduced RAM and CPU usage.
items.v0_2_0_fix_audio_title: Audio Device Switching & Channel Reset Fixes
items.v0_2_0_fix_audio_desc: Improved device plug-and-play handling across multi-soundcard setups, eliminating audio mixing anomalies and resource leaks.
items.v0_3_0_media_desc: Preview inline image links, open the lightbox, and renew access after permission checks. Channels and controls gain interaction animations.
items.v0_3_0_desktop_desc: Configure server addresses at build time, fix local resource loading in installations and incremental updates, and improve four-track denoising comparisons.
items.v0_3_0_security_desc: Upgrade to Electron 41.10.6 to fix known issues with context isolation, protocol access, and sandboxing, and update build dependencies.
